result.brief: 提出动作切场，将动作条件世界模型的局部一阶结构蒸馏进世界动作模型，用 Residual-VAE 潜空间表征未来动力学以提升机器人策略鲁棒性。
result.reason: Distills action-conditioned world model supervision into robot policies via Residual-VAE latent dynamics; main contribution is policy/control, so it maps to the secondary world-model application direction.
